title: Zero-Emission Fleet Milestone and Charging Infrastructure Launch
description: On April 9, the Santa Monica Department of Transportation marked a major milestone with a ceremonial groundbreaking for Big Blue Bus’s zero-emission fleet and expanded charging infrastructure. Backed by a $56M grant from the State, this project advances the city's progress toward cleaner air, smarter transit, and a more sustainable community.
transcript_text: Today we're celebrating a major investment in the future of our system as we begin construction on state-of-the-art charging infrastructure that will support our transition to a fully zero emissions battery electric Big Blue Bus fleet by 2032. What we are doing here in the city of Santa Monica is unique because we have been planning for this for almost a decade. We identified what we would need to make sure we could serve all of our routes with a fully electric buses. We are in the midst of historic transition to ensure that our fleet can be as sustainable as it possibly can and we have been focused on ensuring that our people have the skills, have the experience, have the training that they need to prepare for our fully electric future. This project is more than infrastructure. It's a symbol of what we can achieve when public agencies, private partners, and dedicated individuals align around a shared purpose. Our state transportation agency was thrilled in the fall of 2024 to award your city a $53 million grant from our Transit and Intercity Rail Capital Program. This project of Big Blue Bus would not have been possible without tremendous support from local, county, state, and federal officials through a series of grants, funding that we've received. We're investing in projects like the Big Blue Bus here in Santa Monica because of the outcomes we know it's going to provide for the people of the city, the region, and the community. When transit is reliable and accessible, people choose it and that means that those choices add up to a healthier, more sustainable city. It's about quieter streets and a better quality of life. It's about local jobs and economic opportunity. A more sustainable future, zero emissions, that's something that benefits all of us in our community. By you making the transition that you're making and leading the way, you're going to help us achieve those goals of reducing emissions and and reaching our goals for climate action in the state of California. What we're excited for our Big Blue Bus riders and for the Santa Monica community to experience is the ultimate in a clean, smooth, safe, sustainable ride on our Big Blue Buses.
